primary_scope.interpretation: The paper's main claims are limited to HER2/TROP2 ADC research information. The wider public catalog is supplementary coverage, not an additional primary endpoint.

date_boundary_policy.publication: Use an electronic publication date on or before the cutoff when available. Issue dates after the cutoff remain candidate_pending_verification; indexing or processing dates alone do not establish publication before the cutoff.
date_boundary_policy.clinical_trials: Include records whose source last-update date is on or before the cutoff; report the source snapshot time separately.
date_boundary_policy.approval: Approval dates after the cutoff are excluded from cutoff claims; jurisdiction and current marketing status require first-party source verification.
date_boundary_policy.historical_freeze: The current 2026-09-30-labelled local database is not a reconstructed 2026-09-18 historical snapshot. A cutoff-specific database, raw snapshot manifest, and matching index must be frozen before confirmation results are reported.

current_audit_input.interpretation: diagnostic date audit only; not a historical database freeze
